paragraphs.text: explore a rainy brutalist urban garden in the ruins of an industrial mill. this place is special to me, please take care of it.

petrichor gardens is a contemplative first-person urban exploration game. wander a recursive, non-euclidian sanctuary that doesn't seem to end- an immersive sandbox for meditation, nourishment, recreation, or self expression.

i made this game fresh out of college. i was burned out with all the group projects- the rigid class structure, the grades, the compromises- i wanted to make something all by myself that was completely self-indulgent. i didn't need to pitch this game to anyone or manage anyone else's time, it was just a complete stream-of-consciousness game dev meditation. a detox.

i really wanted to try to capture this feeling i get in march, this total euphoria of rainy weather after months of snow. the wonder and mystery of wandering around in the city alone. a lot of people call this game 'dreary', but some people have really connected with the warmth that i feel when i play it. this place has been rattling around in my head for years and i just wanted to get it out.
